subject: Oceanography
title: Species Migration
description: A micro-lesson that makes Species Migration usable.

hook.text: Marine species are moving toward the poles at 70 km per decade—faster than almost any land species.

buildup.text: As waters warm, species track their preferred temperatures—cold-water fish retreat, warm-water fish advance.

discovery.text: Tropical fish now appear in temperate waters—lionfish have invaded the entire western Atlantic from the Caribbean.

twist.text: Fisheries follow the fish—but political borders don't move, creating international disputes over shifting stocks.

climax.text: Communities that depended on local fish for generations face economic collapse as stocks move away.

punchline.text: Fish don't respect borders—they follow the temperature.

quiz.question: How fast are marine species shifting poleward?
